description_en: Retrieves the status of an integrated image search task
description_zh: 调用该接口获取一体化以图搜图任务的状态
name: GetPictureSearchJobStatus

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html查询
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image search task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206778.html to query the ID
parameters.name: job_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the image search task was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建以图搜图任务的时间

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the search range

JobId.description_en: The ID of the image search task

JobStatus.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

0: initialized
1: no data
2: running
3: succeeded
4: failed
JobStatus.description_zh:
任务状态：
0：初始化
1：无数据
2：运行中
3：运行成功
4：运行失败

SearchPicUrl.description_en: The URL of the search image

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the search range. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 检索范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: Specified access key is not found.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
